LightningComponentBundle.description: Configurable detail section. Build its configuration in the Section Config Builder (/lightning/n/ND_Section_Config_Builder) and paste the result into Field JSON Configuration.

property.name: ND_configBuilderUrl
property.label: ① Set up here → Section Config Builder
property.description: Copy this path into a new browser tab (or find "Config Builder" in the App Launcher) to build the configuration below visually — field rows, section title, icon picker, colour pickers, layout, header alert, a live preview of this component, and validation that catches misspelled keys. Then click Copy JSON there and paste it into Field JSON Configuration. Leave this value alone unless the builder tab has been renamed; it is also the link shown inside the section when it has no configuration yet.

property.name: ND_jsonConfigString
property.label: ② Field JSON Configuration
property.description: PASTE FROM THE SECTION CONFIG BUILDER (path in the box above). It carries everything: field rows and the section title, icon, colours, layout and header alert. Hand-editing works but is unvalidated — a mistyped key does nothing and reports nothing on the page, only to the browser console.
